description: Every request kind Codex routes to the host, each answered from Switchyard: a command (Run once -> accept), a network request (Skip -> decline; Codex takes no message), a file change with its diff from the fileChange item (Run once -> accept), a question (answer -> answers by question id) and an MCP tool call approval elicitation (Skip -> decline). A late answer to a request the server already resolved writes nothing; a server request the adapter cannot handle is answered with a JSON-RPC error. Synthesised from the codex app-server JSON schema generated by codex-cli 0.144.1 (`codex app-server generate-json-schema`), not captured from a live run: replace with a capture (see crates/codex-adapter/README.md).
